fixtures.name: judge placement: skirmish arc and a strung-out column (hold-the-bridge)

placements.rationale: Ordered to screen the approach; the battalion shakes out into a loose arc, sagging in the middle where the ground is softer.
placements.narrative: The 1st Battalion deploys skirmishers in a ragged arc across the road.

placements.rationale: Marching up the road; the tail has lagged and the head is a little ahead of its orders.
placements.narrative: The 2nd Battalion strings out along the road, stragglers trailing.
